messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Plan the work first. Then hand each task to its own subagent with the context it needs, and don't edit the code yourself.

Added **Deal name** under **Reproduce a game**. Names now save and restore with progress; existing unnamed saves remain compatible.

Fixed valid pasted snapshots being rejected because their JSON fields appeared in a different order.

All code changes were delegated to subagents and reviewed. Type checking, 149 unit/static tests, and 84 browser journeys passed.

Changed files pass formatting. The full formatting check still flags 17 pre-existing issues in unchanged files, documented in [README.md](/work/README.md:57).
